scope: Only the two previously blocking worker issues rechecked, plus requested ABI/cache/reducer/A-B/stream/graph/input/guard wiring; kernel source is not re-reviewed.

triton_source_lookup.evidence: load_reducer writes hash-named normalized source to a real .py file in the fresh output parent, verifies any preexisting same-name content, imports via spec_from_file_location, and retains the pinned normalized function SHA. The module is registered in sys.modules before execution, supporting inspect-based Triton source lookup.

cross_stream_dependencies.evidence: The test side stream waits on the current/default stream after input and scratch allocation; timed scratch follows the same wait. Graph capture and replay both use the designated side stream, and side stream is synchronized after replay and before subsequent Q/length writes or host comparisons. Full-case output allocation is followed by a default-to-side wait.

other_requested_wiring.ctypes_launcher_abi: pass: six pointers, batch and scale, eight int64 strides, three output pointers and explicit stream pointer match the isolated launcher interface.
other_requested_wiring.reducer: pass: original source file SHA plus normalized _reduce_partials function SHA are verified; one extracted pinned reducer is reused for A and B with the supplied strides/segment count.
other_requested_wiring.A_B_comparison: pass: each same case/input runs both arm-specific launchers; exact comparisons include partial/max/sum/output and backing stores, with both configured S2/S4 workload families, two Q strides, mixed boundary lengths, and full-length cases.
other_requested_wiring.stream_and_graph: pass after fix: producer and reducer are invoked under the explicit stream; graph capture/replay use that same stream; changed-Q replay is checked after synchronization.
other_requested_wiring.readonly_and_guards: pass: Q, full cache storage, lengths and block table snapshots are compared after ordinary producer/reducer calls; output and partial/max/sum sentinel redzones are checked.
other_requested_wiring.default_behavior: pass: without explicit --gpu, worker reports read-only CPU default and exits without device execution.

decision: GO for the root-owned isolated producer-plus-original-reducer component run with the pinned A/B SOs. This is authorization for that component gate only, not a numerical or performance pass.
